abstract_sentences.text: Large Language Models (LLMs), despite being trained on text alone, surprisingly develop rich visual priors.

evidence.anchor: develop rich visual priors

abstract_sentences.text: These priors allow latent visual capabilities to be unlocked for vision tasks with a relatively small amount of multimodal data, and to perform symbolic visual generation tasks without ever having seen an image.
qualifiers: without ever having seen an image
abstract_sentences.relation: expands the phenomenon before structural analysis

evidence.anchor: without ever having seen an image

abstract_sentences.text: Through systematic analysis, we reveal that visual priors—the implicit, emergent knowledge about the visual world acquired during language pre-training—are composed of separable perception and reasoning priors with unique scaling trends and origins.

evidence.anchor: separable perception and reasoning priors

abstract_sentences.text: We show that an LLM’s latent visual reasoning ability is predominantly developed by pre-training on reasoning-centric data (e.g., code, math, academia) and scales progressively.

evidence.anchor: predominantly developed by pre-training on reasoning-centric data

abstract_sentences.text: This reasoning prior acquired from language pre-training is transferable and universally applicable to visual reasoning.
abstract_sentences.relation: extends sentence 4 from source to transfer

evidence.anchor: transferable and universally applicable to visual reasoning

abstract_sentences.text: In contrast, the perception prior emerges more diffusely from broad corpora, and perception ability is more sensitive to the vision encoder and visual instruction tuning data.

evidence.anchor: emerges more diffusely from broad corpora

abstract_sentences.text: In parallel, text describing the visual world proves crucial, though its performance impact saturates rapidly.
abstract_sentences.comparison: small initial visual text versus additional visual text
abstract_sentences.relation: introduces the second data axis for the recipe

evidence.anchor: performance impact saturates rapidly

abstract_sentences.text: Leveraging these insights, we propose a data-centric recipe for pre-training vision-aware LLMs and verify it in 1T token scale pre-training.

evidence.anchor: verify it in 1T token scale pre-training

abstract_sentences.text: Our findings are grounded in over 100 controlled experiments consuming 500,000 GPU-hours, spanning the full MLLM construction pipeline—from LLM pre-training to visual alignment and supervised multimodal fine-tuning—across five model scales, a wide range of data categories and mixtures, and multiple adaptation setups.

evidence.anchor: over 100 controlled experiments consuming 500,000 GPU-hours

abstract_sentences.text: Along with our main findings, we also propose and investigate several hypotheses, and introduce a Multi-Level Existence Bench (MLE-Bench) to facilitate future research.

evidence.anchor: introduce a Multi-Level Existence Bench (MLE-Bench)

abstract_sentences.text: Together, this work provides a new way of deliberately cultivating visual priors from language pre-training, paving the way for the next generation of multimodal LLMs.
abstract_sentences.relation: places the strongest impact claim at the end

evidence.anchor: deliberately cultivating visual priors

abstract_sentences.text: We recommend a visit to our project page for an interactive reading.

evidence.anchor: project page for an interactive reading
statistical patterns within language might be rich enough to encode fundamental principles of vision

introduction_moves.prior_question: Why can text-only LLMs form visual priors?
introduction_moves.current_answer: The paper frames the phenomenon as paradoxical and operational.

evidence.anchor: generate executable code that renders complex 2D and 3D scenes

introduction_moves.prior_question: Can latent visual knowledge produce visual objects?
introduction_moves.current_answer: Programmatic code can render scenes and support synthetic-data transfer.
introduction_moves.next_hook: Visual adaptation is the second manifestation.

evidence.anchor: high-level reasoning emerges from instruction tuning on a small scale of image-text pairs

introduction_moves.prior_question: Does visual adaptation require massive multimodal pretraining?
introduction_moves.current_answer: Small image-text tuning, unified generation, and vision-only low-level adaptation are presented.
introduction_moves.next_hook: The third manifestation asks whether LLM representations can encode vision.

evidence.anchor: transformer layers of LLMs offer competitive performance on image classification, segmentation, and video understanding

introduction_moves.current_answer: Frozen transformer layers and multimodal neurons suggest modality-general computation.
introduction_moves.next_hook: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis supplies a unifying context.

evidence.anchor: text and images are different "projections" or "shadows" of the world

introduction_moves.prior_question: Can one shared world model explain the three manifestations?

introduction_moves.next_hook: The paper turns this context into a scoped research problem.

experimental_design.name: LLM pre-training scales

experimental_design.name: Two-stage MLLM adaptation
experimental_design.description: Frozen vision encoder plus MLP projector for visual alignment, followed by supervised fine-tuning over vision-language and language-only instructions.

experimental_design.name: Default encoder and optimization
experimental_design.description: MetaCLIP-B/16 and 576 visual tokens; AdamW, cosine schedule, linear warm-up, one epoch, fixed seed 42 and stable loading order.

claim_closure.claim: visual prior decomposes into perception and reasoning components
claim_closure.method_response: Four VQA categories, Spearman matrix, encoder swap and instruction-data removal.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Figure 5 gives within-cluster correlations 0.37 and 0.33; Figures 6–7 separate encoder and tuning sensitivity.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Section 5 recovers systematic deconstruction without adding a new structural claim.

evidence.anchor: not a single entity but decomposes into at least a perception prior and a reasoning prior
Together, results in this section show two mechanisms

claim_closure.claim: reasoning-centric data predominantly cultivates visual reasoning and scales progressively
claim_closure.method_response: Single-source runs, 0–100% ratios, three encoders and reasoning-trace quality.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Figures 3–4, 6 and 10 align source, dose-response, transfer and trace quality.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Section 5 converts the result into deliberate cultivation roadmap.

evidence.anchor: impact of reasoning-centric data is profound and progressive
reasoning capabilities an LLM acquires from text are transferable to vision

claim_closure.claim: perception prior emerges diffusely from broad corpora
claim_closure.method_response: Single-source comparison, MLE size split, encoder swap and perception-data removal.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Web-crawl leads in Figure 3 and Figure 8; Figures 6–7 show encoder/tuning sensitivity.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Only the general cultivation roadmap is recovered.

evidence.anchor: origins of the perception prior appear more diffuse
data diversity is key for perception prior

claim_closure.claim: visual-world text is crucial but saturates quickly
claim_closure.method_response: Fine-grained visual concept/attribute/relationship mixing at fixed total tokens.

evidence.anchor: small initial amount seems to be crucial, but further increases yield diminishing returns

claim_closure.claim: a calibrated mixture improves vision without substantial language loss
claim_closure.method_response: Vision grid search, language-favorable mix0, mix interpolation and 1T two-model validation.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Tables 1–3 identify mix6 and its scale-up metrics.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Section 5 calls for early cultivation of visual priors.

claim_closure.method_response: Pair varying reasoning proportions with MetaCLIP, DINOv2-G and MAE-H.

lexical_analysis.scope: PDF body pages 1–10 and appendix pages 18–31; references, formula fragments, table numerals, headers and figure-axis templates excluded.
lexical_analysis.usage_observation: Domain nouns and concrete experimental actions drive frequency; figure/table template language and extraction splits are marked as noise.

writing_logic.closure_assessment: Main text is self-contained for recipe choice and broad mechanism direction; implementation, parser, benchmark construction and failure interpretation depend on appendix.

statistics_visualization.interpretation_boundary: The paper separates capability score and mechanism narrative, but does not quantify seed dispersion or uncertainty.

formula_summary.theory_role: diagnostic alignment definition and exploratory hypotheses; no guarantee.

final_judgment.single_storyline: Text-only pre-training creates separable reasoning and perception priors; reasoning-centric data scales and transfers, broad/visual text grounds perception, and a calibrated mixture turns those findings into an MLLM recipe. Evidence: pp. 4–10 §§3.2–4.2.
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: The main body keeps task-category definitions, scale/source/ratio interventions, mix6 selection, structural correlation, encoder/removal diagnostics and Table 3 scale-up because each changes the causal interpretation or recipe decision.
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Appendix B/F/G/H/I moves implementation and benchmark construction; A/J/K/L/M move hypotheses, extra results, shortcut behavior, failures and qualitative cases. Main reading remains possible, but exact replication and risk interpretation depend on these pages.
final_judgment.best_pattern: A staged chain of source isolation → dose-response curves → mixture search → cross-category diagnostic → encoder/data removal → 1T validation is the strongest writing and evidence pattern.
final_judgment.largest_gap: Correlation clusters, judge scores and mNN alignment are diagnostic rather than causal proof; rank aggregation, seed dispersion, hardware/reproducibility details and systematic safety audit are missing. Blind tuning adds a performance shortcut with hallucination cases.
final_judgment.transfer_rule: For a latent-capability decomposition, define complementary task channels, manipulate source components while holding volume fixed, run replacement/deletion checks, and close with an independent scale or task validation.
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: The rule is supported for adapter-style MLLM, static-image VQA and controlled data mixtures. It does not automatically cover joint end-to-end multimodal training, discrete visual tokenization, video or safety claims.

evidence_coverage.coverage_note: All result, limitation, closure, layout and final-judgment claims are anchored to PDF pages and sections; anchors are short and page-bounded.
